question: Padma Shri awardee of 2021, Kanaka Raju is associated with which of the following tribal folk dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gussadi.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points:__

__
 
• **Kanaka Raju**

 
 
• He performs as an Indian gussadi dancer.
 
• He received the **Padma Shri honor from the Indian government in 2021 **for his contributions to the arts.
 
• Raju hails from the hamlet of Marlawai in the Komaram Bheem Asifabad district's Jainoor mandal.
 
• Gussadi dancing lessons have been taught by **Raju for more than 40 year**s.
 
• **In 1981, he again participated in the Republic Day procession**.
 
• As of right now, he serves as the Kanaka Raju School of Gussadi dance's chief dance master. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wancho** is a tribal folk dance form of the Wancho tribe in **Arunachal Pradesh, India.** 

 
 
• It is characterized by slow, graceful movements and is performed during festivals and social events.
 
 
 
• **Chalo **dance is performed by the **'Nocte tribe'** of Arunachal Pradesh to celebrate the auspicious festival of **'Chalo Loku'.**
 
• **Popir** is a traditional dance form of the Sherdukpen tribe in **Arunachal Pradesh, India.**
 
 
• It is performed during the Losar festival to celebrate the Tibetan New Year and involves intricate footwork and the use of traditional musical instruments.
